SRC-344:R001.text: AUT-001: host acceptance receipts must be authenticated by the live authority broker (host_authority_client.verify_record), not by caller-supplied field equality or a substring blacklist; matching fields that any caller can write are not host identity.

SRC-344:R002.text: AUT-001: DISPATCH_REQUEST_PERSISTED must never satisfy acceptance; an accepted, turn-started or turn-completed receipt is required, and the receipt status is reported as it is.

SRC-344:R003.text: AUT-001: a malformed numeric receipt field (iteration_id, worker_generation) must be a typed refusal, never an uncaught exception, and a boolean is not an integer.
